karty.priklad: Hoffwn i greu gwefan Gymraeg.
karty.priklad_cs: I'd like to create a Welsh website (creu → [g]reu after hoffwn i; Cymraeg → [G]ymraeg after gwefan, feminine).
karty.mnemo: Like CREate: you CRY (CREU) with joy when you create something.

karty.priklad: Paid â chroesi'r bont!
karty.priklad_cs: Don't cross the bridge! (croesi → [ch]roesi after â, aspirate mutation; pont → y [b]ont, feminine)
karty.mnemo: croes = a cross: you go CRISS-CROSS over the road.

karty.priklad: Dw i byth yn cynhesu bwyd yn y meicrodon.
karty.priklad_cs: I never heat food in the microwave.
karty.mnemo: cynnes = warm: you CAN HEAT (CYN-HES-u) it up.

karty.priklad: Pwy sy'n mynd i dderbyn y negeseuon ffôn yma?
karty.priklad_cs: Who's going to take these phone messages? (derbyn → [dd]erbyn after i)
karty.mnemo: A DEAR old BIN (DER-BYN) receives all your rubbish – it accepts everything.

karty.priklad: Wnaethoch chi ollwng y camera?
karty.priklad_cs: Did you drop the camera? (gollwng → [o]llwng after wnaethoch chi)
karty.mnemo: 'GOAL!' (GOLL-wng) – the keeper dropped the ball.

karty.priklad: Dw i'n mynd i orwedd am hanner awr.
karty.priklad_cs: I'm going to lie down for half an hour (gorwedd → [o]rwedd after i).
karty.mnemo: After the WEDDING (gor-WEDD) everyone needs to lie down for a bit.

karty.priklad: Fydda i byth yn meddwi eto.
karty.priklad_cs: I'll never get drunk again.
karty.mnemo: meddw = drunk: too much MEAD (MEDD-wi) gets you drunk.

karty.priklad: Faset ti'n gwirfoddoli yn yr Eisteddfod Genedlaethol?
karty.priklad_cs: Would you volunteer at the National Eisteddfod?
karty.mnemo: gwir (true) + bodd (willing): you do it of your own true free will.

karty.priklad: Mae hi'n mynnu cael ei harian yn ôl.
karty.priklad_cs: She insists on getting her money back (arian → [h]arian after ei = her).
karty.mnemo: 'MONEY!' (MYNN-u) – she insists on getting it back.

sever.priklad: Mae hi'n mynnu cael ei phres yn ôl.
sever.priklad_cs: She insists on getting her money back (pres → [ph]res after ei = her).

karty.priklad: Neidiodd y ci dros y wal.
karty.priklad_cs: The dog jumped over the wall.
karty.mnemo: 'NEIGH!' (NEID-io) – the horse jumps the fence.

karty.priklad: Fydda i byth yn rhegi eto.
karty.priklad_cs: I'll never swear again.
karty.mnemo: REGGIE (RHEG-i) swears every time he stubs his toe.

karty.priklad: Roedd y cwsmer yn anhapus iawn.
karty.priklad_cs: The customer was very unhappy.
karty.mnemo: an- (un-) + hapus (happy) = unhappy.

karty.priklad: Mae hi'n bwrw glaw mân.
karty.priklad_cs: It's drizzling (literally: it's raining fine rain).
karty.mnemo: A MINI-MAN (MÂN): tiny, like the drops of drizzle.

extra.pozn: the coursebook gives bach as a synonym; it usually follows the noun (glaw mân, oriau mân); before a noun it causes soft mutation (mân bethau ← pethau)

karty.priklad: Dw i'n sicr bod y siop ar gau.
karty.priklad_cs: I'm sure the shop is shut.
karty.mnemo: sicr ≈ SECURE: when you feel secure, you're certain.

karty.priklad: Mae'r drws yn sownd.
karty.priklad_cs: The door is stuck.
karty.mnemo: English 'sound' as in safe and sound: the door is held so soundly it's stuck.

karty.priklad: Dych chi wedi cwyno'n swyddogol i'r Cyngor?
karty.priklad_cs: Have you complained officially to the Council?
karty.mnemo: swydd = a job, an office: something 'of the office' is official.

sever.priklad: Dach chi wedi cwyno'n swyddogol i'r Cyngor?
sever.priklad_cs: Have you complained officially to the Council?

karty.priklad: Mae hi'n gerddor talentog iawn.
karty.priklad_cs: She's a very talented musician (cerddor → [g]erddor after yn).
karty.mnemo: talent + -og (= having): talented.

karty.priklad: Mae'r babi ar ddihun eto.
karty.priklad_cs: The baby's awake again.
karty.mnemo: dihuno = to wake up: ar ddihun = 'on waking' – wide awake at three in the morning.

karty.priklad: Peidiwch â chadw sŵn!
karty.priklad_cs: Don't make a noise! (cadw → [ch]adw after â, aspirate mutation)
karty.mnemo: Literally 'to keep noise' (sŵn = noise).

extra.pozn: listed under 'arall' in the Geirfa box; verb phrase (cadw = to keep)

karty.priklad: Roedd pawb yno heblaw am Siôn.
karty.priklad_cs: Everyone was there apart from Siôn.
karty.mnemo: heb = without is hiding inside: everyone came – without that one, apart from Siôn.

karty.cs_upresneni: arranged or obliged to do something
karty.priklad: Dw i i fod i weithio heno.
karty.priklad_cs: I'm supposed to be working tonight (gweithio → [w]eithio after i).
karty.mnemo: Literally 'to be to' (bod → fod after i).

karty.priklad: Atebwch y cwestiynau isod.
karty.priklad_cs: Answer the questions below.
karty.mnemo: is = lower: isod = below.

karty.priklad: Dw i'n hoffi gwylio rhaglenni materion cyfoes.
karty.priklad_cs: I like watching current affairs programmes.
karty.mnemo: mater = a matter, cyfoes = contemporary.

extra.pozn: listed under 'arall' in the Geirfa box; plural-only noun (singular mater), no gender given

karty.priklad: Oes newid mân gyda ti?
karty.priklad_cs: Have you got any small change?
karty.mnemo: newid = change (also coins); mân = small.

extra.pozn: listed under 'arall' in the Geirfa box; masculine like newid

sever.pozn: north: gen ti instead of gyda ti (L6)

karty.priklad: Roedd hi'n sefyll o fy mlaen i yn y ciw.
karty.priklad_cs: She was standing in front of me in the queue (blaen → [m]laen after fy).
karty.mnemo: blaen = the front.

extra.tvary: o fy mlaen i, o dy flaen di, o'i flaen e, o'i blaen hi, o'n blaen ni, o'ch blaen chi, o'u blaen nhw

karty.priklad: Edrychwch o'ch cwmpas chi.
karty.priklad_cs: Look around you.
karty.mnemo: cwmpas ≈ COMPASS: all the way round.

extra.tvary: o fy nghwmpas i, o dy gwmpas di, o'i gwmpas e, o'i chwmpas hi, o'n cwmpas ni, o'ch cwmpas chi, o'u cwmpas nhw

karty.priklad: Dych chi'n edrych ar eich ffôn yn yr oriau mân?
karty.priklad_cs: Do you look at your phone in the small hours?
karty.mnemo: Literally 'the tiny hours'.

extra.pozn: listed under 'arall' in the Geirfa box; plural-only noun (singular awr), no gender given

sever.priklad: Dach chi'n sbio ar eich ffôn yn yr oriau mân?
sever.priklad_cs: Do you look at your phone in the small hours?
sever.pozn: north: dach instead of dych (L11), sbio instead of edrych (L18)

karty.priklad: Dw i wedi bod yn brysur iawn yn ddiweddar.
karty.priklad_cs: I've been very busy lately (diweddar → [dd]iweddar after yn).
karty.mnemo: diwedd = end: towards the end of the time, i.e. lately.

karty.priklad: Gyda ni heddiw mae Nia Morgan.
karty.priklad_cs: With us today is Nia Morgan.

sever.priklad: Efo ni heddiw mae Nia Morgan.

karty.priklad: Ga i ofyn i'r gwrandawyr am help?
karty.priklad_cs: May I ask the listeners for help? (gofyn → [o]fyn after ga i)
